episode_summary: In this episode, Kelsey Caputo discusses the intersection of AI and real estate, particularly in the luxury market. She emphasizes the importance of using AI as a tool to enhance service offerings while maintaining the irreplaceable value of local knowledge. Kelsey shares insights on building trust with clients remotely and using AI to anticipate buyer objections, offering actionable strategies for agents looking to excel in competitive markets.
